title: December Faith at Work Luncheon
seo_title: December Faith at Work Luncheon in Joplin, MO
description: This is a monthly luncheon where local professionals of faith network, eat, learn, pray, and discuss how to live out their faith in the workplace. This month's topic is Rest, with a panel discussion moderated by Chad Brown, and lunch is sponsored by Life Choices. It takes place December 1, 2026 (time TBD) at the Crowder College Joplin Advanced Training & Workforce Center, 3405 Hammons Boulevard, Joplin, MO.
venue: Crowder College Joplin Advanced Training & Workforce Center
